snippet.textDisplay:
That is what's impressive about Messi. He knows when to give up. He knows he can't perform his best anymore (although after this wild WC 26 performance I doubt it), so he doesn't want to force himself and bring the national team down.
As opposed to other legend, Ronaldo, who, let's be serious, he can't perform anymore. His mind is willing, but the body says no. His legs don't listen to him anymore, but he still insists and dragged Portugal down in this WC.
